correctness.rationale: The proof reduces a possible shattered five-set to five swaps in a rook grid or four swaps plus its center. Johnson distance 0,1,2,>=3 gives exactly all, crosses, two-by-two rectangles, and empty traces. The complete abstract partition census proves fewer than 32 traces in both cases. A separately implemented direct-distance exact check covers every exceptional finite case and every required positive witness; same-rank complement and common-element padding then give all remaining parameters. The certificate ran successfully from the package path.

value.rationale: This is a complete sharp infinite-family complexity invariant for fixed-weight Hamming radius-one balls, with structurally meaningful exceptional cases. Unlike the open-neighborhood theorem, its closed-neighborhood values distinguish J(6,3) and J(7,2), and the rook-grid trace reduction supplies a broadly motivated finite-obstruction technique rather than an arbitrary small computation.
